trigger.name: August 2026 spam update
trigger.evidence: Google's Search Status Dashboard marks the August 2026 spam update Closed. Complete August 22-24 evidence now satisfies the three-day review prerequisite but fails the release test: Network, Smarthome and Pets are down 95.3%, 96.6% and 98.6% in seven-day impressions while production, sitemap, current canonical, manual-action and security checks remain healthy. The freeze therefore remains an evidence-backed search-exposure control rather than an outage response.

freeze.releaseRule: Three complete post-close Search Console days are now available, but their exact host evidence does not support release. Keep new indexable expansion frozen until a later exact cohort gate shows recovery; calendar time alone never unfreezes the portfolio. Owner-authorized, query-backed repairs to existing pages may proceed with a changed-URL ledger and full validation.
